description:
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

 Our ID Capture SDK runs real-time, AR-style computer vision live on the phone camera, on millions of devices. More and more of what our users need now lives next to it, on the web and in the cloud. As a Full Stack Engineer in the ID Capture team, you will build that side: the services, APIs and web interfaces behind our identity verification solutions. You will also build a backend AI routing layer that decides which model handles each request.

 You will join the small team of engineers building ID Capture's cloud and web products: short path from idea to user, and a product that connects live on-device computer vision with modern AI services. 

 If these challenges sound interesting to you, we'd love to hear from you!

 About the role 

 You will work across frontend and backend, own features end to end, and use AI tools every day to move fast. In your first 6–12 months, you will ship a production web service, backend and frontend, that users rely on alongside the ID Capture SDK. 

 What you will do 

 
 Build and run backend services in Python that power our identity verification solutions

 Build web interfaces and internal tooling in TypeScript, from first prototype to production

 Design APIs and data models, and own reliability, monitoring and security of what you ship

 Work with our C++, iOS, Android and ML engineers to connect our on-device products to the cloud

 Use AI coding tools to prototype quickly, then harden what works

 
 Our tech stack 

 
 Python

 JavaScript / TypeScript

 PostgreSQL

 Cloud (AWS / GCP)

 LLM / VLM APIs

 
 Who you are 

 We are looking for a full stack engineer who is comfortable across the stack, from API design and data modelling to UI. You move things forward without waiting for detailed specs, and you handle sensitive data carefully, with privacy in mind.

 
 2–5 years building web applications in production, across backend and frontend

 Solid Python for backend work and good JavaScript / TypeScript for the frontend

 Experience with a major cloud provider and relational databases such as PostgreSQL

 Security-minded, designing with privacy in mind

 Heavy, thoughtful user of AI coding assistants

 Eligible to work in the hiring location

 
 Nice to have:

 
 A modern frontend framework (React, Vue or similar)

 Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure as code

 Experience integrating LLM or VLM APIs into products

 Exposure to identity, security or compliance domains

 Interest in mobile or C++, or in working close to on-device software

 
 What we offer 

 Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their careers at Scandit:

 
 A highly skilled team and a fun environment where you can put your enthusiasm for cutting-edge technologies to use

 Hackathons

 Flexible, office, hybrid or home working

 People-first culture

 Global team outings, Micro Adventures

 Festive/end of year all company celebrations

 Your birthday off

 An attractive individual equity plan in a high growth company

 We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" in 7 countries!

 Excellent office infrastructure, optimized for hybrid working in Zurich, Warsaw, Tampere, and London

 Excellent support for remote work across Switzerland, Finland, Poland, UK, Italy and Germany

 Specific benefits related to the location you are joining

 
 At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all. 

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical [dis]ability or length of time spent unemployed. 

 Imagine the What. Build the How.
